items.q: How many Summit Ridge locations are there?
items.a: Four: Riverton, Fort Worth and Tyler in Texas, and Oklahoma City. Each carries sales, parts and service; Tyler is our truck and trailer parts hub.

items.q: What are the service department hours?
items.a: Most service departments are open 7:00 AM to 6:00 PM on weekdays with Saturday mornings at select locations. Each location page lists its exact hours.
Trailer sales run through our Fort Worth location, and any store can order one for you.

items.q: Do you offer curbside pickup or delivery?
items.a: Yes. Order parts online or by phone for curbside pickup at any location, or same-day delivery within the metro.
North and East Texas and central Oklahoma, with mobile service and Road Assist reaching customers between our locations.
